selection_policy: Low-risk, general-purpose skills aligned with ARA's ML research workflow; critical/high upstream security findings excluded.

skills.name: paper-lookup

skills.name: exploratory-data-analysis

skills.rationale: Supports robust Python figure code generation.

skills.name: scikit-learn
